summary: [para 10] 10. The Commission, vide order dated 28.10.2022 in Petition No. 20/TT/2022, approved the capital cost of ₹2796.91 lakh for Assets-1 to 3 and capital cost of ₹756.22 lakh for Asset-4 vide order dated 30.12.2022 in Petition No. 8/TT/2022. The same capital costs of ₹2796.91 lakh and ₹756.22 lakh with regard to Assets-1 to 3 and Asset-4, respectively, as on 31.3.2019 ha been considered as the opening capital cost as on 1.4.2019 for the purpose of truing-up of the transmission tariff for the 2019-24 tariff period, in accordance with Regulation 19 of the 2019 Tariff Regulations, in the instant Petition. [¶] for its claim, the allowed capital cost as on 31.3.2019 and as on 31.3.2024 for the transmission assets is as follows: [para 31] 31. We have considered the Petitioner’s submissions. The O&M Expenses claimed by the Petitioner in the instant true-up Petition are as per Regulation 35(3) of the 2019 Tariff Regulations. The O&M Expenses in respect of the transmission assets have been worked out as follows: [para 36] 36. Accordingly, the trued-up Annual Fixed Charges allowed for the 2019-24 tariff period in respect of the transmission assets are as follows: [¶] the Combined Assets as on 31.3.2024. Therefore, the capital cost of ₹4008.35 lakh as on 31.3.2024 has been considered as the opening capital cost as on 1.4.2024 for the purpose of determination of transmission tariff for the 2024-29 period in accordance with Regulation 19 of the 2024 Tariff Regulations. [para 48] 48. The capital cost approved as on 31.3.2024 and allowed in the instant order is ₹4008.35 lakh, and the same has been considered for the determination of the tariff for the 2024-29 period. The details of the capital cost allowed in respect of the Combined Assets as on 31.3.2024 and as on 31.3.2029 are as follows: [para 77] 77. The Petitioner has submitted that as per Regulation 36(3)(d) of the 2024 Tariff Regulations, the security expenses and capital spares of more than ₹10 lakh for the transmission system shall be allowed separately after a prudence check. [¶] the Petitioner’s submissions, the Petitioner is allowed to file a single consolidated Petition comprising of security expenses, capital spares individually costing more than ₹10 lakh and insurance expenses on an estimated basis in terms of the 2024 Tariff Regulations for the 2024-29 tariff period.
